Posterior distribution of the number of differential edges

Source: R/mcmc_diag.R
diff_count_posterior.Rd

The number of edges that differ between two groups, recorded at every post-burn-in iteration. Its posterior gives a network-level answer to "do these networks differ?" (p_any, the posterior probability of at least one differential edge) and an estimate with uncertainty of how much they differ, without choosing an FDR level.

Usage

diff_count_posterior(
  fit,
  groups = c(1, 2),
  rule = c("magnitude", "union", "structural", "cut"),
  c = NULL,
  scale = c("pcor", "precision"),
  chain = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

A multiggm_fit or multiggm_fit_list object.

groups

Integer vector of length 2, the groups c(k, m) to compare. Default c(1, 2).

rule

Which edges count as differential: "magnitude" (\(|D| > c\), default), "union" (structural difference or \(|D| > c\)), "structural" or "cut" (mGHS).

c

Threshold for "magnitude" and "union".

scale

Scale of \(D\) and of the rewiring score: "pcor" (default) or "precision".

chain

NULL (default) pools all chains; an integer vector selects chains of a multiggm_fit_list.

Value

An object of class "multiggm_diff_count": a list with draws (the count at every iteration, chains concatenated), mean, sd, quantiles (2.5%, 50%, 97.5%), p_any, groups, rule, c and scale.

Details

With continuous priors (SSVS spike, mGHS) every \(D\) is nonzero, so the count is meaningful only with a threshold c above sampling noise (see the edge-selection vignette). Compare the posterior with the same count under the prior (fit with prior_only = TRUE). The posterior odds of p_any divided by its prior odds is a network-level Bayes factor for any difference, informative only when the prior probability is not close to 1 (with many edges and a small c the prior almost surely has some difference).

See also

node_diff_summary(), select_diff_edges()

Examples

sim <- simulate_multiggm(K = 2, p = 6, n = 60, seed = 1)
fit <- multiggm_mcmc(data_list = sim$data_list, method = "ssvs",
                     burnin = 100, nsave = 100, save_draws = FALSE)
diff_count_posterior(fit, rule = "union", c = 0.1)
#> <multiggm_diff_count> groups 1 vs 2 | rule: union (c = 0.1, pcor scale)
#>   Differential edges: mean 6.2, sd 0.9, 95% interval [5, 8]
#>   P(at least one differential edge) = 1.000
